capabilities: Grow conversations into branching question-answer trees with regenerate and edit-keeps-branch
Let the model search and read vault notes through read-only tools
Run web search through DeepSeek's server-side web_search tool with listed sources
Render Charts and Mermaid diagrams generated by the model
Manage conversation history with tags, filters, sorting, and bulk delete
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.11.4+ for the secret-storage API. Locked to the official api.deepseek.com endpoint; third-party API relays are not supported. No whole-conversation export to Markdown. API key value is held by Obsidian's secret storage, not synced across devices. README is bilingual (English and Chinese) and includes an FAQ and privacy section.
problem: Chat interfaces in Obsidian keep conversations as a single linear thread, so alternative answers and follow-up questions from earlier points are lost when the thread goes the wrong way.

relations.evidence: Requires the Charts (obsidian-charts) plugin installed and enabled in your vault, otherwise the block won't render as a chart.
This needs the Chem (chem) plugin installed; the settings page reminds you if it isn't.

requires.name: obsidian-charts (Charts) for chart code blocks; chem for SMILES molecular structures

summary: DeepSeek chat client that stores conversations as branching question-answer trees, with read-only vault tools, web search, and chart rendering.
